care-mane-brush.name: Mane & Tail Brush
care-mane-brush.description: A paddle brush (Mare Care). Stroke a pony's mane or tail until it sparkles; on desktop look at her mane or tail and hold the mouse button.

care-coat-brush.name: Coat Brush
care-coat-brush.description: A soft body brush (Mare Care). Stroke a pony's coat with it; on desktop look at her coat and hold the mouse button.
